name: cronograma-ms-project
description: Plataforma colaborativa de interpretacao de documentos de engenharia e geracao de cronograma exportavel para MS Project

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cronograma/core && npm run build -w @cronograma/api && npm run build -w @cronograma/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @cronograma/core && npm run test -w @cronograma/api
